data.summary:
One **MONOLITH**, **OBELISK**, **TESSERACT VAULT** or **SENTRY PYLON** model of yours can begin the battle standing on the ziggurat platform of this **FORTIFICATION**. While it remains on the platform, its ranged weapons get **[[HEAVY]](vsdata:weapon-ability/heavy)**.

Any model of yours can be set up on, or end any kind of move on, this **FORTIFICATION**'s ramps or platform sections.
